items.title: Walmart reports strong holiday growth, but earnings outlook falls short of estimates
items.summary: Walmart topped fourth-quarter earnings and revenue estimates, but its current fiscal-year earnings outlook fell short of Wall Street's expectations. Chief Financial Officer John David Rainey told CNBC ...
